notes: Two טֶרֶם morphemes and one waw stand against the ASV's not yet, neither and yet; the count gives neither to the waw as the connective written for it and yet to the second טֶרֶם, whose negation the neither carries (rules 14, 35, 42).
did in did not yet know is the verb's own fronted auxiliary; no interrogative morpheme stands to claim it (rule 17).
